analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to connect their PC to a [product_name] device via Ethernet cable, without internet. They are interested in basic operations like programming, data transfer, and monitoring. Some replies indicate the initial request was unclear, but it was clarified that [product_name] software and optional webserver features can support these tasks. There is an opportunity to make connection procedures more transparent for users.
